## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle (1卷) commentary on the **Qǐng guānshìyīn púsà xiāofú dúhài tuóluóní zhòujīng** 請觀世音菩薩消伏毒害陀羅尼呪經 ([KR6d0288](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0288) = T20n1043) by **Tiāntái Zhìyǐ** 智顗 [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) (538–597), recorded (*jì* 記) by his disciple **Zhāng'ān Guàndǐng** 章安灌頂 [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) (561–632). Preserved as **T39 no. 1800** in the *Taishō*, **2** in the *Northern Yǒnglè canon* / *Jiāxīng zàng* circulation. The *Qǐng guānyīn jīng* (T20 n1043) is one of the canonical Tiāntái-school texts of *Avalokiteśvara* devotional practice, and Zhìyǐ's commentary establishes its place within the Tiāntái doctrinal scheme.

**Abstract**

The *Shū* unfolds the sūtra's title and content under Zhìyǐ's standard Tiāntái scheme of *rén* 人 / *fǎ* 法 (person and method): the "person" is *Avalokiteśvara* (with *tōngbié* 通別 — generic and specific — aspects); the "method" is the dhāraṇī. Each is then unfolded under further sub-distinctions (*yòng* 用 / *tǐ* 體, *néng* 能 / *suǒ* 所), and the whole apparatus is read through the Tiāntái *sānguān* 三觀 method. The commentary is one of the foundational sources for **Tiāntái Avalokiteśvara devotional practice**, particularly for the *xiāofú dúhài* 消伏毒害 ("dissolving and conquering toxic harms") liturgy associated with the dhāraṇī. The *Shū* circulated widely in the Tiāntái lineage before falling into relative obscurity, until **Gūshān Zhìyuán** 孤山智圓 [智圓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%9C%93) (976–1022) revived it by composing his *Chǎnyì chāo* ([KR6j0730](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0730)). Composition: late sixth century, before Zhìyǐ's death in 597.
